title: acilepis aspera
intro: Acilepis aspera, commonly known as the Himalayan teasel, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in Acilepis aspera, such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic effects. The plant has been used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its ability to reduce inflammation and combat infections.
